✦ Eid Milad-un-Nabi ﷺ Mubarak ✦

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

Date:
August 25, 2026

Notification

In pursuance to the notification of Government of Pakistan, Cabinet Secretariat, Cabinet Division vide No. 10-01/2026-Min-II dated August 21, 2026, it is notified for the information of all concerned that the University shall remain closed on
August 26, 2026
on account of Eid Milad-un-Nabi ﷺ (12th Rabi-ul-Awwal 1448 Al-Hijra).

University closed: August 26, 2026 — Eid Milad-un-Nabi ﷺ (12 Rabi-ul-Awwal 1448 AH)

Furthermore, the security staff are required to remain alert and vigilant at their respective points.

Assistant Registrar
